description.value: Sushi Garden is a Japanese restaurant chain with three Burnaby locations, offering a broad sushi menu in a casual sit-down setting. The Brentwood branch is located on Lougheed Highway near Brentwood Town Centre, on a major arterial route through Burnaby. Online ordering and takeout are available at all branches.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Brentwood branch address (4269 Lougheed Hwy, Burnaby, BC V5C 3Y6) and phone (604-294-0104) matching OSM. The site shows online ordering available, indicating takeout; OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes supports a vegetarian option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Required criteria — bike parking or visibility, water bottle refill, and washrooms — are all unconfirmed; website contains no cycling-relevant amenity information.
OSM outdoor_seating=no; no patio visibility for bikes. Bike storage situation entirely unknown.
